high_level_description: stc brand style, a cinematic shot of a figure in a red dress overlooking a cityscape from a stone window.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A sprawling hazy urban cityscape stretching to the horizon under a pale yellow-green sky, a weathered orange-brown stone window frame, dark vertical framing elements on either side.

elements.desc: A figure with long dark hair wearing a bright red traditional dress, viewed from behind at the stone window.
